description: Golden fingerprint cases for computeDesignPlanFingerprint. Two plans with identical normalized content (differing only in map key order, copy fields, confidence, runtime notice text, or timestamps) must hash equal. Any change to target/revision/geometry/material/operations/fit/execution must hash different.

equalPairs.name: map_key_order_does_not_affect_hash
equalPairs.reason: JSON object key order in the source proposedDelta must not affect the deterministic encoding used for the fingerprint.

equalPairs.name: confidence_change_does_not_affect_hash
equalPairs.reason: confidence is excluded from the fingerprint struct by design.

equalPairs.name: review_notes_copy_change_does_not_affect_hash
equalPairs.reason: prose-only review notes are excluded from the fingerprint struct by design.

equalPairs.name: runtime_notice_text_change_does_not_affect_hash
equalPairs.reason: runtime notice copy is excluded from the fingerprint struct by design.

equalPairs.name: timestamp_change_does_not_affect_hash
equalPairs.reason: createdAt/completedAt are excluded from the fingerprint struct by design.
